name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 2), (0, 3), (0, 5), (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 4), (2, 3), (4, 5)] as a QUBO with dimod and solve it with SimulatedAnnealingSampler from dwave-samplers. Verify against brute force. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
